from astropy.io import ascii
from astropy.table import QTable
import astropy.units as u
import io

RST = ascii.RST

def __init__(self, header_rows=None):
    super(RST, self).__init__(delimiter_pad=None, bookend=False, header_rows=header_rows)
    self.data.start_line = len(self.header.header_rows) + 2

def write(self, table):
    lines = super(RST, self).write(table)
    border = lines[len(self.header.header_rows)]
    return [border] + lines + [border]

RST.__init__ = __init__
RST.write = write

tbl = QTable({'wave': [350,950]*u.nm, 'response': [0.7, 1.2]*u.count})
out = io.StringIO()
tbl.write(out, format='ascii.rst', header_rows=['name','unit'])
print(out.getvalue())
print('---read---')
out.seek(0)
t = ascii.read(out, format='rst', header_rows=['name','unit'])
print(t)
print(t['wave'].unit, t['response'].unit)
print('---reverse order read/write---')
out2 = io.StringIO()
tbl.write(out2, format='ascii.rst', header_rows=['unit','name'])
print(out2.getvalue())
out2.seek(0)
t2 = ascii.read(out2, format='rst', header_rows=['unit','name'])
print(t2.colnames, t2['wave'].unit, t2['response'].unit)
print('---default---')
out3 = io.StringIO()
tbl.write(out3, format='ascii.rst')
print(out3.getvalue())
